entries.name: tiny_yeah_install_check
entries.meaning: Parity diagnostic tool name (REQ-TY-020). Verifies library and plugin tool surfaces are 1:1. Reserved: the naming-check gate (REQ-TY-023 F7) requires this name be registered AND present in src/.

entries.name: tiny-yeah
entries.meaning: Root npm package id. Kebab-case per npm convention. Exports map: ./ , ./opencode, ./tui.

entries.name: tool_id_casing
entries.meaning: Convention: every tool id is snake_case with the tiny_yeah_ prefix. Tool ids appear as object keys in the composed registry and as OpenCode tool names.

entries.name: package_id_casing
entries.meaning: Convention: package ids are kebab-case. The tiny-yeah prefix strategy replaces the donor tiny-chu prefix.

entries.name: yeah_prefix_strategy
entries.meaning: Rename strategy (plan.md §3.8, Phase 0 decision B): Tiny-Chu identifiers are renamed using the Yeah* prefix (Yeah* for PascalCase types, yeah* for camelCase, tiny_yeah_ for snake_case tool ids, tiny-yeah- for kebab-case package ids). naming-check MUST NOT flag this strategy as a violation.

entries.name: create
entries.meaning: Overloaded creation verb. Pair with a domain suffix for public APIs (createTinyYeahPlugin, createTinyYeahLibrarySurface).

entries.name: build
entries.meaning: Overloaded factory verb. Pair with a domain suffix (buildTinyYeahTools, buildTaskFocusPacket, buildResumePacket).
